## Improved
- Videos YouTube refuses now say why: private, age-restricted, members-only, Music Premium, removed for copyright, removed by the uploader, removed by YouTube, or a live stream without a recording
- Live streams fill in their title, channel and suggestions without waiting on a second lookup
- Flow no longer bundles NewPipe Extractor, so the app is smaller

## Fixed
- The content language picker offers every language YouTube supports, not only English (UK)
- A blocked stream (HTTP 403) now says so instead of showing a network error
